provenance.source: CodeGraphContext MCP server — documented tool catalog (github.com/raphaelbahat/codegraphcontext)
provenance.refresh: Deliberate refresh: regenerate this snapshot from the live CGC MCP catalog (the `mcp` tool list showing the codegraphcontext server's tools) whenever the server's catalog changes, and bump capturedAt to the capture date. Never edit tool entries ad hoc — the D5 collision test fails when provenance is missing, malformed, or future-dated, so silent snapshot edits are visibly caught in CI.

tools.name: add_code_to_graph
tools.behavior: Performs a one-time scan of a local folder to add its code to the graph. Ideal for indexing a new codebase before querying.

tools.name: add_package_to_graph
tools.behavior: Add a package to the graph.

tools.name: analyze_architectural_evolution
tools.behavior: Analyze repository growth trend and identify Technical Debt Hotspots (combining code complexity and change frequency).

tools.name: analyze_code_relationships
tools.behavior: Analyze code relationships like 'who calls this function' or 'class hierarchy'.

tools.name: calculate_cyclomatic_complexity
tools.behavior: Calculate complexity of a function.

tools.name: check_job_status
tools.behavior: Check the status and progress of a background job.

tools.name: delete_repository
tools.behavior: DESTRUCTIVE AND IRREVERSIBLE. Permanently deletes a repository and every node and relationship associated with it.

tools.name: discover_codegraph_contexts
tools.behavior: Discover .codegraphcontext folders.

tools.name: execute_cypher_query
tools.behavior: Run a read-only Cypher query against the code graph.

tools.name: find_code
tools.behavior: Find relevant code snippets related to a keyword (e.g., function name, class name, or content).

tools.name: find_datasource_nodes
tools.behavior: Query datasource nodes.

tools.name: find_dead_code
tools.behavior: Find potentially unused functions.

tools.name: find_java_spring_beans
tools.behavior: Find Spring beans.

tools.name: find_java_spring_endpoints
tools.behavior: Find Spring endpoints.

tools.name: find_most_complex_functions
tools.behavior: Find most complex functions.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.behavior: Generate codegraph report.

tools.name: get_repository_stats
tools.behavior: Get repository statistics.

tools.name: list_graphs
tools.behavior: List all available graphs in the FalkorDB instance. Each graph typically corresponds to an indexed repository.

tools.name: list_indexed_repositories
tools.behavior: List all indexed repositories.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.behavior: List all background jobs and their current status.

tools.name: list_watched_paths
tools.behavior: List all watched directories.

tools.name: load_bundle
tools.behavior: Load a pre-indexed graph bundle (.cgc) into the database. Note that clear_existing=True is destructive.

tools.name: search_registry_bundles
tools.behavior: Search registry bundles.

tools.name: simulate_architectural_change
tools.behavior: Simulate architectural modifications (service decomposition, adding/removing dependencies, deleting modules).

tools.name: simulate_metrics
tools.behavior: Calculate repository architectural metrics (coupling, cohesion, circular dependencies, complexity).

tools.name: switch_context
tools.behavior: Switch active graph context. Refuses while any indexing job is PENDING or RUNNING.

tools.name: unwatch_directory
tools.behavior: Stop watching a directory.

tools.name: visualize_graph_query
tools.behavior: Generate a Neo4j visualization URL for a Cypher query.

tools.name: watch_directory
tools.behavior: Continuously monitors a directory and keeps graph updated.
